summary: Warm editorial infrastructure language for capital, capacity, constraints, and operating choice.

rendering.line: thin architectural rules with occasional vermilion or cobalt emphasis
rendering.texture: quiet warm paper field with no decorative noise
rendering.depth: layered bands, field blocks, and asymmetrical mass rather than shadows
rendering.material: warm paper, ink, cobalt evidence, vermilion constraint, muted green leverage

visual_thesis: Infrastructure is a physical system before it is a software story.
composition_behavior: Use one dominant action per page.
Prefer asymmetric title fields and constructed stack geometry.
Use continuous rules for flow and field matrices for joint variables.
Use rule-led decision rails instead of repeated rounded cards.
typography_behavior: Use oversized grotesk headlines for the first read.
Use compact monospace metadata, page numbers, and source labels.
Keep body copy short and presentation-scale readable.
image_treatment: No raster imagery required; editable geometry carries the argument.
prompt_fragment: Design a warm editorial infrastructure report with one focal action per page, physical stack geometry, continuous rules, field matrices, and restrained cobalt/vermilion/green semantics.
review_focus: readability of matrix and decision rails
